synthesizedFindings.description: SQL injection vulnerability in login module combined with missing OAuth token validation tests creates a high-risk scenario. This file should not be merged without addressing the security issue.
synthesizedFindings.recommendation: Priority 1: Fix SQL injection. Priority 2: Add OAuth security tests. This is a blocker.

synthesizedFindings.description: The login function is too complex (80 lines, multiple responsibilities) which makes it difficult to test all paths. Extracting functions would improve both testability and coverage.
synthesizedFindings.recommendation: Extract OAuth validation and password checking into separate functions before merging. This improves test coverage and maintainability.

recommendations.description: Fix SQL injection vulnerability in login query
Add comprehensive tests for OAuth2 token validation and refresh
Extract authentication logic into separate functions for better testability
Extract magic strings to constants file
Use async password hashing to avoid blocking event loop
